subject: gk
question: Who among the following succeeded K Sivan as the ISRO chairman, in January 2022?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**S Somanath**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Appointments Committee has approved the appointment of rocket scientist **S Somnath, Director Vikram Sarabhai Space Center** (VSSC) to the post of **ISRO Chief **and **Chairman ISRO.**
 
• **S. Somnath** will succeed** K Sivan **who completes his extended tenure on **14 Jan 2022**.
 
• He has been appointed for a combined tenure of** 3 years **from the date of joining.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ISRO Established**- 15th August 1969
 
• **ISRO Headquarters**- Bengaluru, Karnataka.
 
• **ISRO Chairman**- S Somnath. (As of Jan 2024)
 
• Recently ISRO launched the **Chandrayan 3 Mission** on **14th July 2023** from **Shriharikota, Andhra Pradesh** and it successfully did a soft landing on the lunar South Pole of the moon.
 
• India became the** first country** in the world to do this** soft landing on the South Pole** and also it became the **fourth country to reach the South Pole of the moon.**
